data.one_liner: Mathematical, collection, and statistical utility library for Dart extending dart:math.
data.what_it_does: Extends Dart SDK and dart:math functions with additional mathematical calculations, collection operations, and statistical analysis methods. It provides singletons and extensions for lists and maps to simplify math, statistics, and data processing.
use_when: You need helper functions like factorials, primes, LCM, or base logarithms in Dart.
You want easy statistical measures (mean, median, mode, standard deviation) on lists of numbers.
You need regression analysis (linear, quadratic, cubic, quartic) on paired numerical data.
avoid_when: You need complex matrix operations that require specialized linear algebra packages.
strengths: Comprehensive set of math and statistical extensions for lists and maps.
Includes advanced utilities like regressions and combinations.
weaknesses: Limited documentation beyond basic code examples and auto-generated dartdocs.
Relies on singletons and extensions which might not fit all architectural preferences.
